definitions.averaging: Pooled recall is hits/positive pairs; conditional macro recall averages users with positives in that stratum. Empty strata use null.
definitions.coobservation: Maximum over this user's TRAIN context items of the number of TRAIN users observing both source and target. The evaluated user never observes target in TRAIN.
definitions.genre: Provided catalog genre tokens; fraction of target genres present in union of TRAIN-history genres, and maximum source-item genre Jaccard. This is descriptive overlap, not a fitted content predictor.
definitions.head: Top ceil(20% of real catalog) by TRAIN count, ties by original item token; tail is complement.
definitions.limits: Available cooccurrence or broad genre overlap is not proof of useful identifiable preference signal. Overlapping seed splits are not independent observations.
definitions.relevance: Every original VALID record for the unchanged472 development users; no rating threshold.
definitions.support: Number of distinct TRAIN users observing the target item, regardless of rating.
